verse_en: Four keepers guard the names of things.
Two stand alone; two stand with kin.
Ask the name whose keeper it is. Its ending may lie.
Not every name is known. The unknown walk as strangers.
A stranger alone speaks short; in company the word grows.
Even a stranger keeps the kind of the name it guards.
The oath of -AR is broken at its end,
and each who swears it leaves a mark upon the stem.
Read the mark, and know who speaks.
The oaths of -ER and -IR walk as one,
and part only where we and you all speak:
there each keeps the letter of its own oath.
